description:
The Magical Quest Starring Mickey Mouse is a 1992 SNES platformer developed by Capcom.
Pluto has disappeared and his pal Mickey is hot on his trail!
Pluto's tracks lead Mickey to a magical world full of perils.
As he travels through the land, Mickey meets a kind, old wizard who tells him that the
evil Emperor Pete has snatched poor Pluto!
Summoning his courage, Mickey vows to free his pal and sets off toward Emperor Pete's Castle.
Along his treacherous trek, Mickey will find three special costumes which will aid him in his journey.
Wizard Costume - allows Mickey to attack with magic and breathe underwater.
Firefighter Costume - allows Mickey to shoot water to put out fire and push blocks.
Mountaineer Costume - allows Mickey to use a grappling hook to scale mountains and traverse rough terrain.

v0.2.0.description:
# Version v0.2.0
## Bug Fixes
- The Stores would sometimes lock Upgrade Location checks if the player had received the Upgrade AP Item before checking the location.
- Location checks in Snowy Valley 5-1 weren't always sent until the player entered Snowy Valley 5-2.

## New Features
- Level selection on top of the existing Stage selection.
- In-game Tracker for Location checks.
- Treasure Boxes now drop a generic AP Item. Location checks are sent after picking up this Item.
- All Stores now have a Big Heart Location check.
- Sound and Text notifications when receiving AP Items.
- Text notifications when sending Location checks.

## Gameplay adjustments
- Fire Grotto's Mini-boss now has reduced health when the player enters the fight without the Wizard Costume.

## New YAML Options
- Costume Upgrades as Progressive Costume AP Items.
- Snowy Valley Stage Boss Logic toggle.
